issue.title: Staged monitor from a failed turn is never adopted and silently strands its epic phase
issue.description:
Observed live on athena, 2026-11-07 through 2026-11-12, while diagnosing why epic
sase-1r2 (v0.19.0 release) sat stalled for five days.

Sequence:

1. Phase agent fork `sase-1r2.6--2` staged monitor `3w69pb9ezmfy` (member
   `sase-1r2.6--mon-2`, "Full CI round 2", 12h budget) at 2026-11-07 11:50 EST
   (bead sase-1r2.6 note #9).
2. That provider turn later ended `DONE (failed)` (after ~125 blocked-on-landing
   heartbeat notes, #11-#136).
3. The staged monitor was never adopted: five days later `sase monitor show 3w69pb`
   still reports status `? staged`, no pid, ELAPSED `—`, and `sase agent list` never
   showed `sase-1r2.6--mon-2`.
4. Phase bead sase-1r2.6 stayed IN_PROGRESS with its dead agent as assignee, land
   agent sase-1r2.land stayed parked on `waiting_for: ["sase-1r2.6"]`, and nothing
   surfaced STRANDED or notified anyone. Recovery only happened manually: a takeover
   under a different plan's stale-owner rule (note #137) and a human-prompted unstall
   tale on 2026-11-12.

This is a third shape beyond the `202611/stranded_adopted_staged_handoff.md` survey:
shape 1 (delivered staged handoffs owning forever) was fixed 2026-11-05 (binding
0.43.3), and shape 2 (done monitor with stale followup_pending, bead sase-1re) requires
lifecycle `done` — this member was never started at all, staged two days AFTER the
shape-1 fix by a turn whose outcome was `failed`.

Root-cause check needed before fixing:

- Does host completion intentionally skip adopting staged handoffs when the turn
  outcome is `failed`? If yes, the staged record must be expired or surfaced
  (STRANDED/notification), not left as a silent zombie that future turns treat as a
  pending handoff (it also blocked `sase questions` escalation, note #16).
- Does `stranded_work` classification (owner_kind() in sase-core) treat a staged
  never-started member as a live owner of its bead the way shape 2's done-monitor
  branch does?
